text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Day and night, soaked and simmered repeatedly... all sorts of soybeans!
The time has finally come for them to become miso...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We'll develop a fantastic Pearl-brand miso and breathe new life into the miso world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"The possibilities of miso are truly infinite!
Ho-ho-ho-ho-ho!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because she was so absorbed in making miso day after day,
Seeking the Pearl ended up staying up late every night...
